Create a production-ready single-file website in one html file.

GOAL
Build a premium event landing page for **“ARTIFACT: Museum Night”** — a ticketed night museum event with ticket selection, but no real payment.

TECH / STRICT
- One html file only.
- HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript only.
- No frameworks.
- No libraries.
- Inline CSS and inline JS.
- Remote images are allowed.
- Must work by opening the file directly in a browser.

DESIGN DIRECTION
Create a visually striking cinematic museum-night website.

The design should feel like:
- luxury museum after dark
- velvet darkness
- golden spotlights
- quiet mystery
- art-house cinema
- premium cultural event

Visual style:
- dark velvet / near-black background
- deep burgundy and midnight navy gradients
- soft spotlight effects
- elegant serif headlines
- modern readable sans-serif body text
- thin gold dividers
- subtle grain/noise overlay using CSS only
- large editorial hero layout
- asymmetric image cards
- glass-like dark panels
- premium ticket cards
- smooth hover states
- scroll reveal animations
- strong typography hierarchy

Color palette:
- Background: `#070506`
- Velvet: `#1a0710`
- Burgundy: `#3a0f1d`
- Midnight navy: `#07111f`
- Gold: `#d6ad60`
- Soft gold: `#f3d79b`
- Ivory text: `#f8efe2`
- Muted text: `#b9a999`
- Panel: `rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.06)`
- Border: `rgba(214, 173, 96, 0.28)`

TYPOGRAPHY
Use CSS font stacks only:
- Headlines: `Georgia`, `Times New Roman`, serif
- Body: `Inter`, `system-ui`, `Segoe UI`, sans-serif

LAYOUT
Single-page landing with sticky navbar and smooth scrolling.

SECTIONS

1. Navbar
- Logo: ARTIFACT

1. Sticky navbar (blurs on scroll): logo ARTIFACT, links Program(#program) Artists(#artists) Venue(#venue) Tickets(#tickets) FAQ(#faq), CTA "Get Tickets". Active nav state via IntersectionObserver with aria-current. Mobile hamburger toggle (aria-expanded, closes on link click and ESC).
2. Hero full viewport: background image https://source.unsplash.com/featured/2400x1400?museum,night with dark overlay + gold spotlight radial gradients + slow animated spotlight; eyebrow "ARTIFACT: Museum Night", huge serif h1 "Museum Night, Reimagined" (italic gold on "Reimagined"), lead text, meta badges: 18 October 2026, 19:00–02:00, The Old Gallery, Warsaw, plus small badges "One night only", "Limited capacity", "18+"; buttons Get Tickets (#tickets) and Save to Calendar (data-ics). Scroll indicator.
3. Concept (#concept): editorial paragraph with drop cap, asymmetric layout, 3 feature cards: After-hours exhibitions, Live performances, Guided hidden-room tours, each with inline SVG icon.
4. Program (#program): vertical timeline with gold line and dots, items rendered from JS data: 19:00 Doors Open, 19:30 Curator Welcome, 20:00 Hidden Collection Tour, 21:00 Live Ambient Performance, 22:00 Sculpture Hall Projection, 23:00 Artist Talk, 00:00 Midnight Gallery Walk, 01:00 Closing Sound Session; each with time, title, description, location tag (e.g. Grand Foyer, Rotunda, Vault Wing, Sculpture Hall...). Alternating on desktop, single column on mobile.
5. Artists (#artists): 8 cards from JS data, asymmetric grid (some cards offset/taller), images cycling through: https://source.unsplash.com/featured/1200x900?gallery,art ; ?exhibition,lights ; ?sculpture,museum ; ?museum,crowd ; ?art,installation ; ?theater,stage (reuse first two for 7,8). Fictional names/roles (curator, sound artist, projection designer, etc.), teaser, "View details" button. Accessible artist modal (role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby, focus trap, restore focus, close button, ESC, backdrop click, body scroll lock): image, name, role, longer bio, session time.
6. Venue (#venue): The Old Gallery, address "ul. Krakowskie Przedmieście 15, 00-071 Warsaw" (fictional), cards for travel tips, accessibility notes, parking & public transport. Inline SVG map mock: dark navy bg, street lines with labels, gallery block labeled, metro marker "M" and bus marker, entrance marker, animated dashed gold route line (stroke-dashoffset animation), legend. role="img" with aria-label.
7. Tickets (#tickets): 3 premium ticket cards (ticket stub look with perforated divider notches): Night Pass €29 (Entry after 19:00, Main exhibition access, Program access); Curator Pass €59 recommended badge, highlighted (Everything in Night Pass, Hidden collection tour, Reserved artist talk seating); Patron Pass €129 (Everything in Curator Pass, VIP lounge access, Signed event print, Priority entrance). Hover lift + gold glow. "Select tier" buttons open ticket modal: tier select (radio or select prefilled), attendee name, email, quantity stepper 1–10 with − / + buttons, live total price, terms checkbox, "Confirm reservation" button, notice "No payment is processed". Validation with inline error messages (aria-invalid, aria-describedby), on success show success state inside modal with reservation code (random like ART-XXXX) and toast.
8. FAQ (#faq): accordion with buttons aria-expanded/aria-controls, animated height, 7 Q&As including the required 6 (payment not processed — demo; arrive late allowed till 01:00; photos allowed without flash except marked rooms; venue accessible; change tier via email up to 48h before; calendar via Save to Calendar button .ics).
9. Newsletter: email input + submit, novalidate, inline regex validation error message, success toast, reset.
10. Footer: ARTIFACT logo, credits (curated by..., photography Unsplash), social text links (Instagram, Vimeo, Newsletter, Press), © 2026 ARTIFACT, note "Demo landing page — no real ticket purchase." Also a Save to Calendar link.

Toast system: aria-live polite container, stacked toasts auto-dismiss after 4s, types success/info/error.
